name: Nginx Proxy Manager

database.label: Bundled SQLite by default; MySQL/MariaDB optional for larger setups

resourceFootprint.notes: Lightweight — a Node.js backend plus Nginx, idling around 150 MB of RAM on a fresh install in our test LXC. Footprint grows mainly with the number of proxy hosts and traffic. Needs ports 80/443 free on the host and port 81 for the admin UI.

dockerComposeSnippet:
services:
  npm:
    image: jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:latest
    container_name: nginx-proxy-manager
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "81:81"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt
descriptionEn: Nginx Proxy Manager is an open-source reverse proxy with a clean web UI, built so you can expose your homelab services under real domain names without ever editing an Nginx config file. It handles proxy hosts, redirections, TCP/UDP streams and free Let's Encrypt SSL certificates with automatic renewal, plus access lists and basic user management. It is a popular first step for anyone moving from raw IP:port links to https://app.yourdomain.com, and it runs comfortably in a small unprivileged LXC container.
descriptionBg: Nginx Proxy Manager е open-source reverse proxy с чист уеб интерфейс, създаден за да публикуваш услугите от homelab-а си под реални домейн имена, без да редактираш Nginx конфигурационни файлове. Управлява proxy хостове, пренасочвания, TCP/UDP streams и безплатни Let's Encrypt SSL сертификати с автоматично подновяване, плюс списъци за достъп и основно управление на потребители. Популярна първа стъпка за всеки, който преминава от голи IP:порт адреси към https://app.yourdomain.com, и работи спокойно в малък непривилегирован LXC контейнер.
taglineEn: Reverse proxy with a simple web UI and free SSL certificates.
taglineBg: Reverse proxy с прост уеб интерфейс и безплатни SSL сертификати.
